I wrote `main.wj`, and it passes Example 1 under `wj run --compiled`: the output matches the expected text exactly. I didn't run Example 2 (the trapezoid) or an empty input, so those paths are untested.

It defines a `Shape` trait with `name`, `corners` and `double_area`, and one struct per shape kind. It reads stdin, prints one line per shape, then the total and the largest. The first shape wins
